ensure_fitted_raise: ensure all ScaleFactor modules in a PyTorch module tree are fitted, raising ValueError if any are not
ensure_fitted_warn: check all ScaleFactor modules in a PyTorch module tree are fitted, logging a warning instead of raising
review_ensure_fitted: review the ensure_fitted function that validates ScaleFactor modules are fitted before inference
test_ensure_fitted: test the ensure_fitted function with a module containing unfitted ScaleFactor children
refactor_ensure_fitted: refactor ensure_fitted to support custom error messages for unfitted ScaleFactor modules
